show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/cfsDXF
show.description: After a failed experiment, a brilliant scientist from a parallel universe accidentally collides with another dimension and wakes up on Earth inside the body of Bhavya,  Confused and unfamiliar with Earth’s customs. she begins learning about Bhavya’s past and the planet’s culture while pretending to be Bhavya. Now, she must decide whether to continue living as Bhavya until she finds a way back home or embrace the new life she has unexpectedly entered.
